profile.headline: Document Composition Professional
profile.geoLocationName: Los Angeles County, California, United States
profile.jobTitle: Advanced Software Engineer - HP Exstream Administrator
profile.summary:
Accomplished professional with 20+ years experience in various aspects of IT application development.  A self-starting, detail oriented individual, who works well with others to meet corporate goals through strong communication and organizational skills augmented with strong analytical and problem solving skills.

Successfully delivered multiple high impact projects from inception through implementation

Extensive experience in document composition, print and digital imaging areas utilizing HP Exstream Dialogue, Elixir, and StreamWeaver software

Background in Health Care, Auto Insurance, and Banking industries

Highly experienced in areas of system analysis, design, implementation, quality assurance testing, performance and management  

Coordinated and validated offshore and onshore associate project deliverables, ensuring quality and completeness

In depth understanding of change management and release management process

Excellent verbal and written skills, especially with regards to presenting findings to both technical and non-technical audiences

Understanding of software development methodologies such as System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Project Development Life Cycle (PDLC)

Hold a Position of Trust with the Defense Industrial Security Clearance Office for the Department of Defense

positions.title: Advanced Software Engineer - HP Exstream Administrator
HP Exstream Developer
positions.description: Design, create, and maintain various HP Exstream applications.

positions.title: Senior Associate - Projects
positions.description:
Creation of Business System and Technical System Design documents

Creation of Business Area Requirement documents

Responsible for all areas of application testing including unit, system, integration, user           acceptance

Administrator, developer, and production support for multiple document composition / print application software including, HP Exstream Dialogue, Elixir, Solimar Print Delivery, Pitney Bowes Finalist, Verimove, StreamWeaver, and FlexServer Software

As the document composition, print, and archival Subject Matter Expert provided support and knowledge transfer to offshore staff
